posts.name: Google Gemini
posts.text: Plus up your furniture with 3D-printed accessories using Gemini 4 Argon. Upload a pic with rough measurements, and use Canvas in Gemini to build an interactive 3D CAD studio where you can explore styles, tweak live sliders, and export printable STLs to upgrade your space.
